newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on late recovery.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on late recovery.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed higher on a late short covering rally tied to positioning after the sharp break in the market Tuesday, traders said.
Futures were under pressure most of the day on active seedings of the U.S. spring wheat crop, traders said.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 3/4 to two cents per bushel higher, with July up 1-3/4 at $4.04-1/4.
Wheat futures volume was estimated by the MGE at 18.289 million bushels, below the 20.331 million traded Tuesday.
MGE barley futures closed unchanged with July at $6.70 per cwt.
